items.note: The prompt asks whether the July Pro price increase from 49 to 69 USD drove Pro churn, and says not to give a general overview.
The prompt says to exclude trials (is_trial = yes).
The prompt says to exclude QA/test accounts with emails ending in @ourco.test.
The prompt says a row with a cancel_month is churned.
The prompt says the result goes to the CEO and the summary is written for the CEO.
The prompt asks for a summary of at most 5 bullets.
The prompt asks for one suggested chart that is described, not built.
The prompt asks how confident the conclusion is given the small sample, and adds what extra data would raise confidence.
